title: Trisha
coverAlt: Trisha barbershop website home page on a desktop browser and a phone: a dark page with a barber pole, tools and a gold booking button.
brief: A single-location barbershop needed to replace its pen-and-paper appointment book with a phone-first scheduler.
summary: Website for a traditional barbershop, with four-step online booking and a small shop.

gallery.title: Problem
gallery.alt: Trisha board 2, From the paper appointment book to the phone: the brief, the customers and the home page that leads with one gold action.
gallery.caption: The home page leads with one gold action, 'Zakaži termin', then moves to a short about section on a paper ground.

gallery.title: Key flow
gallery.alt: Trisha board 3, Service, date, time, details: the four booking screens with a progress line above.
gallery.caption:
The shop has one chair, so there is no barber picker. The flow is four steps with a progress line above.
Service: full-width rows show name, duration and price before anything is chosen.
Date: a strip of days with the closed day greyed out, and a 'Pun kalendar' button for later dates.
Time: half-hour slots in a four-column grid, the chosen service pinned above.
Details: name and phone first, email marked optional, a line says why the phone is asked.

gallery.title: Responsive
gallery.alt: Trisha board 4, One page, three widths: the home page and the price list at desktop 1280, tablet 768 and phone 375.
gallery.caption:
Desktop, 1280: title, two actions and three figures centred over the hero art.
Tablet, 768: same centred stack on a taller frame.
Phone, 375: the two buttons stack.
Desktop: the price list runs in two columns.
Phone: one column, price right-aligned.
Phone: the premium service keeps its gold-edged block.

gallery.title: Design system
gallery.alt: Trisha board 5, Warm dark, gold and paper: colour swatches with hex values, four typefaces, buttons, script toggle and progress line.
gallery.caption:
Colours: mustard, brown, cream and paper, with green for success and red for danger.
Cormorant Garamond Italic 700: headlines, service names, prices.
Oswald: buttons, navigation, toggle.
JetBrains Mono: step labels, durations, times.
Inter: body text.
Solid gold primary, thin-outline ghost.
Progress line: gold now, green done.

gallery.title: Details
gallery.alt: Trisha board 6, The booking parts, up close: selected service, date strip, time slots, booking header, shop grid and product page.
gallery.caption:
Selected service: gold outline and a tick, the price stays in the same place.
Date strip: weekday, number, month; the closed day is hatched and faded.
Time slots: even tiles, mono figures, the chosen one outlined in gold.
Booking header: back link left, page title centre, the script toggle right.
Shop: category filter chips above a four-column product grid.
Product page: large image, price in gold, quantity and one wide add button.

gallery.title: Scope
gallery.alt: Trisha board 7, What the site covers: public pages, booking, shop, script switch, installable web app and tools.
gallery.caption:
Public pages: home, services, gallery, shop, legal pages.
Booking: four steps, service to details.
Shop: products with quantity and cart, pickup in the shop.
Script: Serbian in Cyrillic and Latin, switchable.
Installable: web app with an offline page.
Tools: Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, hand-written CSS.

problem: The shop also sells a few care products alongside the services.
users: Customers range from 18 to 60+. They book from a phone, and they need to know that the time slot is real and what it costs before they commit.
note: The screens show the design as delivered. Prices, ratings and opening hours inside the screens are the client's content.
